name: VRM_DEVOLVED_PERF_OBLIG_DTL_GT
description: Oracle internal use only. This global temporary table is used in recognize revenue of customer contracts job during internal processing of devolved performance obligations.

columns.name: DEVOLVED_PERF_OBLIG_DTL_ID
columns.description: Detailed devolved performance obligation unique record identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation unique identifier of the devolved performance obligation.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Customer contract header unique identifier of the devolved performance obligation.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_DEVOLVED_PO_AMT
columns.description: Devolved performance obligation amount in the contract currency. This amount is the sum of the apportioned promised detail line net consideration amounts in the contract currency for the accounting period. The accounting period is determined based on the satisfaction date.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_ALLOCATED_AMT
columns.description: Devolved performance obligation allocated amount in the contract currency. This amount is the sum of the apportioned promised detail line allocated amounts in the contract currency for the accounting period. The accounting period is determined based on the satisfaction date.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_RECOG_REV_AMT
columns.description: Devolved performance obligation recognized revenue amount in the contract currency. This amount is the sum of the processed satisfaction event type accounting events amount of the promised detail lines for the accounting period. The accounting period is determined based on the satisfaction date.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_INITIAL_PERF_EVT_AMT
columns.description: Devolved performance obligation initial performance event amount in the contract currency. This amount is the sum of apportioned promised detail line allocated amounts in the contract currency for the accounting period. The accounting period is determined based on the satisfaction date. This amount is used to create initial performance event type accounting events for the devolved performance obligation.

columns.name: INITIAL_PERF_EVT_EXPECTED_DATE
columns.description: Date of the expected creation of the initial performance accounting event. For the first accounting period record, this date is computed as the earliest of the bill dates and the satisfaction start dates for the promised detail lines. For the other accounting period records, this date is computed as the earliest of the satisfaction start dates for the promised detail lines.

columns.name: INITIAL_PERF_EVT_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the initial performance accounting event was created. N indicates not created. Y indicates created.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the satisfaction is measured for promised detail lines where the satisfaction measurement model for the line is based on the period satisfied. The default satisfaction date will be the last date of the accounting period for which the satisfaction is measured.

columns.name: REVERSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this devolved performance obligation record is reversed. N indicates not reversed. Y indicates reversed. Not reversed records are the latest records.

columns.name: FIRST_RECORD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the current record is the first devolved performance obligation record, after sorting based on the satisfaction date under the performance obligation.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier of the customer contract.

columns.name: DEVOLVED_PO_DETAIL_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. This column is used to maintain the status of each record in this table at each level of processing in the Recognize Revenue of Customer Contracts process.
